title: REBUILD Evidence Record
description: One claim in the evidence library, with its label, source grade and provenance.

claim.description: The claim as stated, in one sentence.

source_status.description: How the material was obtained. 'calculated' covers a reproducible calculation from stated inputs.

source_date.description: Publication or retrieval date, ISO where possible.

sample_or_method.description: Sample size and method, when applicable.

relevance.description: Relevance to the decision at hand — independent of quality.

limitations.description: Known weaknesses: coverage, recency, bias, conflicts of interest.

calculation.description: Inputs and formula, when the claim is a calculation rather than a citation.

grade.description: Source quality, graded separately from relevance. A first-party, B official or audited, C credible secondary, D expert judgment, E untested planning assumption.
